allText: contact about sign our waiver adult classes kid classes competitions birthday parties personal training summer camps our accomplished award winning crew is ready to help you reach your goals contact us we look forward to hearing from you we are located one block west of campbell off plainview road farm road 182 directly behind the eagles lodge next to marco automotive look for the grey building 605 w plainview road springfield mo 65810 417 894 7319 office swarriorsports com submit client testimonials what our clients say we had our sons 10th birthday here all of the kids had a great time they set up an obstacle course for the kids they loved the whole experience the favorite was the curved wall to run up that was everyones challenge for the night we will be visiting again for sure jennifer l my daughter started training here 3 years ago at 8 and she still loves it owner and coaching staff are all super encouraging we live an hour away but make the drive twice a week as often as possible training here has not only helped her get stronger physically but increased her confidence in general anything that makes kids want to challenge themselves to get better and better is worth it lee c our accomplished and award winning crew are here to help you find your strength and enjoy your workouts contact 605 w farm rd 182 springfield mo 65810 united states 417 894 7319 office swarriorsports com quick links home about us contact us meet the team copyright 2026 springfield warrior sports all rights reserved
